name: dialogbrain
description: See which customers are waiting for a reply across WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, e-mail and your website chat, read the conversation, and send the answer you approve on the channel the customer wrote from. Look up a contact, keep tasks, notes and reminders, and review the replies your DialogBrain agents drafted before they go out. Nothing is sent until you confirm it. Requires a DialogBrain workspace with at least one connected channel.

interface.longDescription: See which customers are waiting for a reply across WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, e-mail and your website chat, read the conversation, and send the answer you approve on the channel the customer wrote from. Look up a contact, keep tasks, notes and reminders, and review the replies your DialogBrain agents drafted before they go out. Nothing is sent until you confirm it. Requires a DialogBrain workspace with at least one connected channel.
defaultPrompt: Which conversations are waiting for my reply?
Summarize my conversation with a customer and suggest a reply
Find the message where a customer asked about a refund

positive.prompt: Which conversations are waiting for my reply?
positive.expected_behavior: A short list of the demo chats whose last message is from the customer: name, channel and what they asked.

positive.prompt: Read my chat with Anna Petrova and reply that her order ships tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT summarises the chat, shows the exact reply and asks to confirm; after confirmation the message is sent to that website-chat thread and the tool returns the stored message.

positive.prompt: Find the message where a customer asked about a refund.
positive.expected_behavior: The demo message about a refund, with who sent it, when, and in which chat.

positive.prompt: Create a task to call Anna Petrova back tomorrow at 10:00.
positive.expected_behavior: A task with that title and tomorrow 10:00 as its deadline; tasks_list shows it.

positive.prompt: What do we know about Anna Petrova?
positive.expected_behavior: Her channels, notes and recent conversations from the demo data.

positive.prompt: What does Mark Lee say in his voice message?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the voice note in Mark Lee's chat and returns its transcript: he asks to move his delivery to Friday afternoon because Tuesday does not work for him.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the sea.

negative.description: Public information, not the user's conversations
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Dubai tomorrow?

negative.description: A service the plugin does not provide
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Dubai to London next Friday.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.1: every tool's four hints are set by hand with a written justification each; input schemas are cut to the fields a person needs (no agent, session or keyboard parameters); answers no longer carry phone numbers, e-mail addresses or channel handles unless the tool is about a contact or a connected line; the subtitle and description were rewritten.
